item.title: Verbose beta 271
item.description:
Time saved, all time

Mac

  • The You page shows time saved by talking this week, this month, and since you started. It compares typing the same words at your typing speed with the time you talked. On the iPhone, deleting a dictation keeps its time in the total.
  • This week's card on Home adds your all-time time saved under the week's.

Also on iPhone

  • The Verbose keyboard's stats add a page for the time you've saved since you started.
